automation.name: Free VRAM before a generation (automatic)
automation.description: Before each generation, unload Ollama's models when the generation needs more VRAM than is currently free - or when the need can't be estimated (eviction is cheap and chat reloads in seconds, so 'when in doubt, clear the room'). The generation waits for the eviction (or a short timeout) before it starts. To use a fixed threshold instead, swap the Expression node for a Compare node on event.vram_free_gb (e.g. lt 8).

config.expression: event.vram_estimate_gb is none or event.vram_free_gb is none or event.vram_estimate_gb > event.vram_free_gb
